dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical geometric narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical indentations observed along the left lateral margin; the right margin is comparatively linear though partially obscured by edge shadows.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to pale-blue median pixel intensity; categorized as a sub-adult pigmentation phase below mature white reflectance.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse dark-pixel clusters localized primarily across the upper and central dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, low-gradient transition between darker pigmented regions and the primary light-grey baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of faint, longitudinal linear markings on the upper dorsal plane; one distinct high-contrast white focal point is visible on the lower-left lateral margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint longitudinal linear scars, possibly rake marks, are visible on the upper to mid-dorsal surface.
